already_documented: BCM43455c0/BCM4339 arbitrary time-domain TX from Template RAM, including repeated playback.
present_work_distinction: This work receives selected time-domain words while a native collector remains active and exports them concurrently to Linux.
limits: TX sample playback and RX sample collection are different directions; these selected TX files do not prove global absence of RX work.

already_documented: BCM43455c0 CSI on Pi5, selected per Wi-Fi frame, with complex channel estimates sent in UDP packets.
present_work_distinction: This output is a time-domain selected-sample stream that does not require a decoded frame to trigger each output block.
limits: Pi5 support and complex-valued export are already known; CSI is not equivalent to a general time waveform.

already_documented: Raw time-domain RX on BCM4389c1; this routine waits for a finite capture, disables capture, then decodes on-chip.
present_work_distinction: The sustained host path here targets a different exact chip/firmware and repeatedly publishes selected words during one active capture.
limits: Raw RX on Broadcom Wi-Fi is already established; do not transfer BCM4389c1 calls or claim a first Broadcom receiver.

already_documented: Continuous filtered/decimated S3 IQS output over native USB, with output indices and CRCs; public PR4 is merged.
present_work_distinction: The present exact-target mechanism uses Cortex-R4, D11 collection and SDIO owned-RAM export on BCM43455c0.
limits: Continuous commodity Wi-Fi SDR and FIR processing are already public; rate or soak comparisons are not controlled head-to-head experiments.

already_documented: Experimental S31 RX DMA, reusable output ring, transport ownership, sample indices and explicit drop accounting.
present_work_distinction: These general stream-design concepts are reused ideas; our contribution can describe the specific BCM43455 implementation and evidence.
limits: No claim that rings, atomic publication, ownership, discontinuity tracking or concurrent export are independently new.

already_documented: Public exact-family patching environment and memory metadata; public tree also contains the manufacturing image.
present_work_distinction: The receive/stream implementation and image-specific lifecycle are additional code and evaluation.
limits: This definitions file selects STA, not MFG; its addresses cannot be treated as the complete experimental MFG ABI. Binary availability is not redistribution permission.
